title: Generation plugin output
description: Output contract for interface code-generation plugins. Describes the files produced from a specification. An empty files array is still valid output. For Go, the host owns go.mod and rewrites its module directive to match package.name.

files.description: Generated files. Paths must be unique within the array.

GeneratedFile.description: A single generated file and its contents.

path.description: Destination path relative to the generation root. Use POSIX separators. Must not be absolute or contain '..' segments.

contents.description: File contents as a UTF-8 string. Empty string is allowed.
